Night Market

Player's guide: every trait, unit, item and augment. Tap any name to jump to it.

TraitsUnitsItemsAugmentsStatuses
Units cost 1 to 5 gold. Three copies merge into a 2-star, three 2-stars into a 3-star. A unit fills its mana by attacking and being hit, then casts its ability.
Traits switch on when you field enough different units that share one. Most units have an origin and a class.
Items: two components on the same unit combine into a completed item. A unit holds three.
Emblems are items that make the holder count as one more unit of a trait.
Augments are permanent bonuses you pick from three, a few times a game.

Unit cost: 12345   Ability numbers read 1-star / 2-star / 3-star. Health and Attack grow with stars; the other stats do not.

Traits

Origins Where a unit comes from.

Fox

Emblem: Fox Mask = Moon Shard+Fortune Slip

Every Fox enters with an illusion of itself beside it. The illusion has 30 / 42 / 55% of the Fox's health, casts the Fox's own ability, borrows 50% of the Attack and Ability Power the Fox has from items and the like, and deals 30 / 42 / 55% of its damage and healing.

  • 2Illusions with 30% health, borrowing 50% of the Fox's bonus Attack and Ability Power, dealing 30% damage and healing
  • 4Illusions with 42% health, borrowing 50% of the Fox's bonus Attack and Ability Power, dealing 42% damage and healing
  • 6Illusions with 55% health, borrowing 50% of the Fox's bonus Attack and Ability Power, dealing 55% damage and healing
Fox KitFox DancerFox ThiefShrine FoxNine-TailsTamamo

The Gamblers roll the dice as the fight starts and all of them take what comes up: critical strikes, speed, toughness or power. At 4 the stakes are doubled.

Emblem: Ink Stone = Moon Shard+Mochi

Ink units stain what they hit, each in its own way; the trait deepens the stain. Stains they apply deal 60 / 90 / 100% more damage. At 4, when an Ink unit kills a stained enemy the stain runs onto the enemies beside it.

  • 4Stains deal 90% more; a stained enemy they kill spreads its stain

Vendor

Emblem: Stallholder's Apron = Moon Shard+Lacquered Plate
